# DELIVERY_POLICY

How manifests reach the cluster, what bootstraps the applier, and how long an apply may take.

<!-- Generated by nix build .#referencePages -->

Canonically `delivery`. A floe providing this must declare it
as `provides.delivery`; a hole that resolves it may be called
anything.
